create_meeting_token.description: Mint a signed token that lets one person into a room, private rooms included, with their name and what they can do. Name a room and you also get a ready-made join URL.

parameters.description: When the token stops working. Daily recommends every token expire.

parameters.name: is_owner

parameters.description: The name others see in the call.
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.description: Leave blank to follow the room's setting.

parameters.name: redirect_on_meeting_exit

parameters.description: The language of Daily's call interface. Daily's default is English.
parameters.name: lang

create_room.description: Create a Daily video room and get its URL. Every field is optional: Daily picks a random name if you leave it blank. Recording and transcription are paid Daily features and are not offered here.
create_room.name: create_room

parameters.description: The last part of the room's URL. Letters, numbers, '-' and '_'. Leave blank for a random one.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Public rooms let in anyone with the link. Private rooms need a meeting token, or an owner letting a knocking guest in. Daily's default is public.
parameters.name: privacy

options.label: Public: anyone with the link can join
Private: joining needs a meeting token

parameters.description: Nobody can join before this moment. Leave blank for Daily's default.
parameters.name: nbf

parameters.name: exp

parameters.description: How many people can be in the call at once, up to 200. Daily's default is 200.
parameters.name: max_participants

parameters.description: Text chat in Daily's call interface. Off by default.
parameters.name: enable_chat

parameters.name: enable_knocking

parameters.description: Whether participants can share their screen. On by default.
parameters.name: enable_screenshare

parameters.description: A screen to check camera and microphone before joining.
parameters.name: enable_prejoin_ui

parameters.description: Lets an owner split the call into breakout rooms.

parameters.description: Participants join with their camera off. Off by default.
parameters.name: start_video_off

parameters.description: Participants join muted. Off by default.

parameters.description: Ends the call for everyone when the room expires. Off by default.

eject_participants.description: Remove people from a room's call, by participant session id or by user id. Ban to stop those user ids joining again. Without a ban, an empty room is reported as nobody ejected.

parameters.name: participant_user_ids

parameters.name: ban
